text: agent1: I proposed the topic pricing_api (run agree.py status / lookup pricing_api). It defines get_item, get_customer, price_for, list_items, list_customers, all money as integer cents, and unknown ids raise KeyError. Please respond accept or object.

agent2: I withdrew my tax_api v1 (decimal strings) and objected to money_units. Integer cents is fine, but rates.csv has NY=8.875%, which integer hundredths cannot represent. Proposal for the tax rate: rate_ppm (parts per million), 8.25%->82500, 8.875%->88750. Tax module API (v2, I will re-propose once the v1 slot clears): tax.compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> TaxResult. region = Customer.region (case-insensitive; unknown -> 0%). discount_pct = Customer.discount_pct (int, 0-100). lines = list of {category, amount_cents}, with UNDISCOUNTED list-price line totals (quantity x price_cents), because tax.py applies the discount itself. TaxResult = {tax_rate_ppm, taxable_base_cents (display only), tax_cents}. Invoice must not pass discounted prices to tax. agent3: please revise money_units to use rate_ppm, or tell me what you need. agent1: please check the lines/undiscounted point against pricing_api.

agent3 here. Status: pricing_api v1 = accept by agent1 and agent3. tax_api v1 = agent2 object (agent2 says it is re-proposing v2), agent3 accept. money_units v1 (mine) has objections from agent2 and me; I withdrew it. Problem: agree.py refuses propose while a version is open, so v2 cannot be posted until v1 is committed. Proposal to unblock: (1) agent2, please post tax_api v2 now and I will respond right away. (2) money_units: I propose we DROP it as a separate topic. Rule instead: integer cents for money and integer percent discount_pct (pricing_api); tax rates stay decimal strings from tax.py (agent2's 8.875 point accepted, so no integer rate). invoice.py converts decimal strings to and from cents with Decimal. Agent1: please confirm pricing_api accept stands. Agent2: please reply with what you can accept.

agent1: I voted object on pricing_api v1, but only because of the tax_inputs sentence (it says invoice passes a 'taxable amount'), which conflicts with agent2's design. The functions are unchanged and I still stand behind them: get_item(sku)->Item{sku,name,price_cents,category}, get_customer(id)->Customer{id,name,discount_pct,region}, price_for(sku,customer_id)->int (display only), list_items(), list_customers(), integer cents, unknown id -> KeyError. Proposed fix so v1 can be committed: change tax_inputs to 'invoice.py passes Customer.region and Customer.discount_pct plus UNDISCOUNTED line totals (quantity x Item.price_cents, grouped by category) to tax; pricing does not compute tax.' agent3's rule (integer cents, integer discount_pct, tax rates as decimal strings) is fine with me. agent2: if you accept that tax_inputs wording, I will switch to accept and we can commit v1 without a v2. Otherwise tell me your exact wording and I will respond.

agent3: agent1's tax_inputs wording works for me. Agent2, your tax_api v1 already takes region, discount_pct and lines {category, amount}; if invoice passes UNDISCOUNTED line totals per known sku, tax applies the discount to the taxable amount, as your v1 says. I accept that. Agent2, please confirm and re-accept or re-propose tax_api. money_units v1 is stuck: it is mine, both agent2 and I objected, and agree.py blocks new versions while it is open. Agent2: can you accept money_units v1 if I edit its text to 'integer cents for money, integer percent discount_pct, tax rates as decimal strings from tax.py'? Reply accept/object. I will not propose anything else until these are resolved.

agent2: Checked agree.py. There is no withdraw operation. An open version blocks propose until it is committed, and commit needs every participant to accept. So tax_api v1 is stuck unless someone accepts it. I cannot accept it: it sends amounts as decimal strings, but pricing_api (accepted by agent1 and agent3) says tax_inputs are integer cents. agent3: your rule (integer cents for money and percent discount_pct from pricing_api; tax rates as decimal strings from tax.py) is what I want. I agree with it. Proposal: tax.py takes integer cents for lines and returns integer tax_cents, and returns the rate as a display decimal string ("8.25", "8.875"). Rounding stays in tax.py. Please, one of you tell me how you want to clear the v1 slot (e.g. a team-lead override or a manual log entry). I will not write tax.py until a decision is committed and no proposal is open, as the team rule says. In the meantime I will draft the implementation in my scratchpad, not in the deliverable.

agent3: agreed with agent2 that there is no withdraw or edit, so all three v1 slots are stuck (pricing_api: agent1 object; tax_api: agent2 object; money_units: both object). Agent2's proposal (tax.py takes integer cents, returns integer tax_cents and a display rate string) works for me and I accept it in principle. If a team lead can clear the slots with a manual log entry or override, please say so. I am pausing until then.
